name: shop-print-agent
description: Local background agent (runs on the seller's own PC) that lets the shop's admin/POS screen print receipts and charge a bank card terminal silently on that PC's own hardware — the web server itself has no access to hardware on a machine it isn't running on.

scripts.build: npm run bundle && pkg bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/shop-print-agent.exe
